text: hm. seems that my image cased all the skins to strip in the compiled path
resolution: Root-caused and fixed. The image didn't break the bake — it exposed a stale host binary. Chain: the user's rebuilt editor (req_0695 fix) now actually persists materials, so the localstore 'custom-textures' value grew to 69,223 bytes (stencils + the new image decal). But tools/v8cli — the TRACKED prebuilt host that 'rjit game bake' spawns — was still the Jun 9 build with the old fixed 64KB localstore read buffer, so its read of the >64KB value returned EMPTY: zero custom materials reached the bake ([materials] 8 baked, 0 decal recipes) and every custom-skinned face shipped flat. Adding the image is exactly what pushed the list over 64KB, hence 'my image caused all the skins to strip'. Fix: rebuilt v8cli from the fixed framework (alloc-based reads, no read cap) and refreshed the tracked tools/v8cli copy (mv-over; the old one was mid-execution). Re-ran the bake: [materials] now bakes 11 (9 shader, 1 translucent, 1 decal) and the decal image asset ships content-addressed (key 3001, 51,809 bytes from the user's Desktop jpg). zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile is freshly baked with everything in — the next Compile/world entry shows the skins and the image.
